description: Update an existing resource by UUID (partial update of attributes and/or relationships). JSON:API: PATCH /jsonapi/{entity_type}/{bundle}/{uuid}. Body is { data: { type, id: uuid, attributes?, relationships? } }.

entity_type.description: The entity type machine name, e.g. "node", "taxonomy_term", "user".

uuid.description: The entity UUID (JSON:API uses the UUID, never the numeric id).

name: drupal_update_resource
title: Update resource
